verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS identity-verification platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk export, no open-format download and no offboarding path. The REST API for processing applicant data [sumsub-docs-1] is only a developer building block from which an export could be built, not a documented export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
